candidate.relatednessRule: If future evidence ever makes this candidate ledger-eligible, it must remain a second package-event record within the existing event_stream_2018 family and must not create a new independent campaign family or validation unit.

npmIncidentNotice.statement: npm identifies flatmap-stream@0.1.1 as the malicious package and reports that it was added as a direct dependency of event-stream@3.3.6 on September 9, 2018.

independentSnykPostmortem.statement: Snyk identifies flatmap-stream@0.1.1 as the injected release and records an October 5, 2018 release timeline.

independentMicrosoftNotice.statement: Microsoft identifies flatmap-stream as malicious and records blocks for 0.1.0, 0.1.1, and 0.1.2 alongside event-stream@3.3.6.

strictExclusionReason.requiredRule: A primary temporal-ledger record requires an official registry timestamp for an independently corroborated affected release and a retained official-registry source object selected strictly before the resulting cutoff.
strictExclusionReason.observedState: The bounded current registry response lacks a 0.1.1 time-map entry, lacks all 0.1.x time-map entries, and retains no historically relevant 0.1.x version object. A later security-holder object does not supply event-time or pre-event source evidence. Therefore no official exact cutoff or pre-event source-object selection can be reconstructed.
strictExclusionReason.consequence: Do not add flatmap-stream to the 14-record primary ledger, do not create a companion source snapshot, direct declarations, range approximations, recursive graph edges, a new campaign family, or a new validation unit from this candidate.

prohibitedInterpretations: This exclusion does not dispute the independently corroborated flatmap-stream incident evidence or convert any unretained version into a benign, safe, unchanged, no-known-event, or control row.
Current registry retention is not historical release evidence and cannot supply a package source, authority, dependency, workflow, provenance, installation, or outcome feature.
The documented relationship to event-stream is relatedness evidence only; it does not establish a new independent campaign family, validation unit, causal pathway, or campaign-complete census.
This artifact does not license reach, blast-radius, attack-return, ranking, calibration, PR-AUC, Recall@K, logistic regression, uncertainty, or predictive claims.
